name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
summary: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries. These interfaces and languages provide ways of interacting with computer systems and are a common feature across many different platforms. Most systems come with some built-in command-line interface and scripting capabilities, for example, Android is a UNIX-like OS and includes a basic Unix Shell that can be accessed via the Android Debug Bridge…

strategies.name: Detection of Command and Scripting Interpreter

analytics.name: Analytic 1741
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Command and Scripting Interpreter from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Command Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App spawns sh, bash, toybox, toolbox, or su child process with command arguments within $ShellActivityWindow$ of shell launch — child shell process with arguments is the script execution signal]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [App invokes Runtime.exec(), ProcessBuilder.start(), or JNI-backed command execution framework to spawn shell or command interpreter…

analytics.name: Analytic 1742
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Command and Scripting Interpreter from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Command Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Shell process (sh, bash) or command-executing child process spawned under app context on supervised iOS device — any shell spawn on stock iOS indicates jailbreak or kernel exploit]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [Managed iOS app invokes lower-level process-launch behavior or command-execution-equivalent activity outside sandbox-permitted APIs on supervised…
